teacher_metadata.desired_pose_initialization: actual settled qpos, not persistent actuator target

reference.label: adapted quasistatic algorithm teacher using measured swing shapes
reference.order_selection: selected measured peak source times ascending

smoothing.stage: XY and inferred-plane world height before detection

extraction.fallback: none; raise ValueError if no measured positive segment

normalization.y: remove linear endpoint drift; divide by positive source x span
normalization.z: subtract linear endpoint height baseline; clamp >=0; normalize native then resampled peak to 1

reference.schedule: one leg at a time; d=stride/6; completed +stride; all -(i+u)*d; active +stride*xshape; cycle resets algebraically to zero

frames.source_time_s: active selected measured segment clock, remapped each step; not a continuous animal clock

active_swing_time_adaptation.applies_to: active measured x/y/z and source_time_s only; body/stance progress stays linear u

reference.derivatives: piecewise linear measured shapes, chain dpdu/step_s; internal shape-knot jumps retained; C1 internal step/cycle seams with all x velocities -stride/(6*step_s), y/z zero; zero before start and at/after finite end (finite-end stop is not C1)
reference.stance: all true except active leg when target_z>1e-12; target labels are not measured contact
limitations: Adapted wave timing, NOT exact original animal timing
Teacher-only virtual phase/clock; never deployment NN phase input
Targets only; no root writes, no physics claims
Source is keypoint-fitted kinematics; inferred plane is not contact/force
No hold or blend; parent supplies settle and optional transition
Physical feasibility and absolute target SI NOT_ESTABLISHED

teacher_metadata.force_allocation: teacher-only planned load: all-six baseline fit, then caps baseline_fraction*activation for partial feet, 2 for full stance; activation=1-smoothstep(clip(reference_height/contact_transition_height,0,1)); zero caps omitted; no forces applied
teacher_metadata.torque: tau_ff=(bias-passive-sum(J_z.T*fz))[actuated_dofs]; gravity_ff false sets feedforward to zero
teacher_metadata.rate: qdot_des+(desired_motor_target-current_target)/target_tau_s; clip +/-2 and target bounds over command_dt_s
limitations: Vertical quasistatic support ignores horizontal friction and angular contact wrench
Actual velocity bias is retained; inertia is omitted from predicted statics
Unbacked planned supports are hypothetical, explicitly flagged
COM within support hull and small root residual are necessary, not sufficient
Finite motor torque/rate and target bounds can prevent tracking
No gait success or neural autonomy follows from these mathematical checks
